topic: Air India captain under investigation for marijuana use after flight incident
headline: AIR INDIA CAPTAIN UNDER INVESTIGATION FOR MARIJUANA USE AFTER FLIGHT INCIDENT LEAVES 24 INJURED
summary: The captain of an Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi is under investigation after a confirmatory drug test revealed the presence of marijuana. The test was conducted after a preliminary screening gave a 'non-negative' result. The incident occurred on August 4 when the flight experienced a sudden loss of altitude, resulting in 24 people being injured. The Ministry of Civil Aviation had ordered the testing after the incident.
